# @mission-platform/speech-audio

Framework-neutral browser speech & audio composables for Mission Platform.

## Core Hooks

### useSpeechSynthesis
`useSpeechSynthesis(): SpeechSynthesisControls`
Text-to-speech via the native SpeechSynthesis API. Returns `{ isSupported, isSpeaking, isPaused, voices, speak, pause, resume, cancel }`.

### useSpeechRecognition
`useSpeechRecognition(): SpeechRecognitionControls`
Speech-to-text via the native SpeechRecognition API (`webkitSpeechRecognition` fallback). Returns `{ isSupported, isListening, transcript, error, start, stop, abort }`.

### useSound
`useSound(src?: string): SoundControls`
Plays an audio clip from `src` (HTMLAudioElement) and synthesizes tones via the Web Audio API. Returns `{ isSupported, isPlaying, play, stop, playTone }`.

### useMidi
`useMidi(): MidiControls`
Web MIDI access and note playback. Returns `{ isSupported, isConnected, inputs, outputs, error, requestAccess, playNote }`.

## Implementation Details
- Authored against `@mission-platform/forge-jsx` neutral hooks and compiled to React, Vue, Solid, Svelte, and Web Components.
- SSR-safe (`isSupported` is `false` and controls are no-ops when the browser API is undefined).
- Automatic cleanup on unmount (speech cancelled, recognition aborted, audio stopped, contexts closed).
